# Feature: Settings Route with Configurable API Base URL

## Overview
Add a dedicated `/settings` route where the user can view and update the backend API base URL at runtime. Whenever a URL is set (on page load, after Save/Reset, and via manual Retry), the page probes the backend and shows an online/offline indication backed by the new `GET /api/health/` endpoint (Feature 3). This page has only this single option for now, but establishes the settings page shell, routing, and persistence pattern for future options. It reuses the current Light/Dark theme system with no new visual language.

## User Stories
- As an Admin user, I want to open a settings page so I can see which backend API my board is talking to.
- As an Admin user, I want to update the API base URL and have it persist across reloads so I can point the client at a local, Docker-internal, or deployed backend without rebuilding.
- As an Admin user, I want an immediate online/offline indication whenever the URL is set so I know if the backend is reachable before returning to the board.
- As an Admin user, I want the settings UI to respect my Light/Dark theme choice so the experience stays consistent.

## Implementation Plan

### UI Components
- `client/src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx` — new page component rendered at `/settings`. Layout mirrors `ProjectsPage.jsx`: `.projects-page` container, header with title + subtitle, `← Back to Board` link via `wouter` `Link`, single settings card with form + API status indication.
- `client/src/components/ApiStatusBadge.jsx` (or inline block in `SettingsPage.jsx`) — status indicator with three states: `checking` (gray, spinner, `role="status"` "Checking…"), `online` (green dot, "Online"), `offline` (red dot, "Offline — backend unreachable"). Shows checked URL + last-checked time + Retry button (`type="button"`).
- `client/src/pages/SettingsPage.test.jsx` — Vitest + React Testing Library coverage (renders current URL, saves valid URL, rejects invalid URL, resets to default; mocks `systemApi.checkHealth` for online/offline/checking states, asserts Retry re-probes).
- `client/src/services/api.js` — add `systemApi.checkHealth()` → `apiRequest("/health/")` with 5 s `AbortController` timeout; any network error/timeout/non-2xx/invalid body resolves to offline (never throws to the badge).
- `client/src/App.jsx` — add `<Route path="/settings"><SettingsPage /></Route>` inside existing `<Switch>`. No layout changes.
- `client/src/components/Navbar.jsx` — add settings nav link (`Settings` icon from `lucide-react`, `Link href="/settings"`), with active-state detection via `useLocation()` following the existing `isProjectsPage` pattern.
- `client/src/index.css` — reuse existing tokens (spacing/radius, `.btn`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-primary`, `.project-message`, form input styles from `CreateProjectForm`). Add minimal `.settings-card` class only if existing card styles cannot be reused; no new color palette.

### Data Model (Mock)
No backend model changes. Client-side persisted config in `localStorage`:

```js
// localStorage key
"task-tracker:api-base-url" // string, e.g. "/api" | "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api" | "http://localhost:8000/api"

// Effective resolution order
const DEFAULT_API_BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "/api"
const stored = localStorage.getItem("task-tracker:api-base-url")
const effectiveBaseUrl = stored ?? DEFAULT_API_BASE_URL
```

Mock examples for UI-first development:
```js
{ label: "Default (relative)", value: "/api" }
{ label: "Local Django", value: "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api" }
{ label: "Docker host", value: "http://localhost:8000/api" }
```

### Simulated Backend
Backend probing is live via Feature 3 (`GET {base}/health/` → `{ "status": "ok", "db": "ok" }`). Until Feature 3 lands, use the stub `systemApi.checkHealth() → { status: "ok", db: "ok" }` for UI-first development.
- `getApiBaseUrl()` returns effective URL (stored override or env default).
- `setApiBaseUrl(url)` validates then persists to `localStorage`; trims trailing `/`.
- `resetApiBaseUrl()` removes the override key.
- Validation rule: non-empty, must start with `/` or `http://` or `https://`, no whitespace; show inline error via `role="alert"` following `ProjectsPage` error pattern.
- Success confirmation message + display of effective URL; no page reload required.
- Health semantics: HTTP 200 with `status === "ok"` → online; anything else (fetch reject, abort/timeout after 5000 ms, non-2xx, bad JSON) → offline. Probe triggers on mount, after Save, after Reset, and on Retry click; in-flight probes are aborted on unmount or superseded URL change to avoid race conditions.

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Extend `client/src/utils/apiClient.js`: keep `API_BASE_URL` export for backward compat, add `DEFAULT_API_BASE_URL`, `API_BASE_URL_STORAGE_KEY = "task-tracker:api-base-url"`, and exported helpers `getApiBaseUrl()`, `setApiBaseUrl(url)`, `resetApiBaseUrl()`, `isValidApiBaseUrl(url)`. Change `apiRequest()` to resolve `getApiBaseUrl()` at call time instead of the static const so runtime updates take effect without reload.
2. Create `client/src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx`: on mount read `getApiBaseUrl()` + `DEFAULT_API_BASE_URL`; controlled text input prefilled with effective URL; Save button calls `setApiBaseUrl()` and shows success state; Reset button calls `resetApiBaseUrl()` and restores default; inline validation error; hint text showing examples (`/api`, `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api`). Use `useTheme()` implicitly via global `data-theme` — no per-page theme logic.
3. Add `systemApi.checkHealth()` in `client/src/services/api.js` (calls `apiRequest("/health/")` with `AbortController` timeout of 5000 ms; returns parsed `{ status, db }` on success, throws/returns offline signal otherwise) plus `ApiStatusBadge` UI in/used by `SettingsPage.jsx`: `status` state (`checking | online | offline`), `useEffect` probe on mount + whenever effective URL changes, Retry button re-invokes probe, abort on unmount; offline message shows checked URL so a typo is obvious.
4. Wire route in `client/src/App.jsx`: `import { SettingsPage } from "./pages/SettingsPage"` and add `<Route path="/settings"><SettingsPage /></Route>` next to `/` and `/projects` routes.
4. Update `client/src/components/Navbar.jsx`: import `Settings` from `lucide-react`, add `<Link href="/settings" className="btn btn-secondary">` with active detection (`location === "/settings"`), placed next to Projects/Board links.
5. Add styles in `client/src/index.css` only if needed (`.settings-card`, `.settings-form`, `.settings-hint`, `.api-status-badge` + `.is-online/.is-offline/.is-checking` reusing spacing/radius tokens and existing success/error colors); remove any inline styles per Sprint 3.3 policy.
6. Create `client/src/pages/SettingsPage.test.jsx`: mock `localStorage`, assert default rendering, valid save persists key, invalid input shows `role="alert"` and does not persist, reset clears key; mock `systemApi.checkHealth` to cover online badge, offline badge + Retry re-probe, and checking state. Run `pnpm test:run` and `pnpm check`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `/settings` route renders a page containing only the API base URL option, styled with the current Light/Dark theme.
- [ ] Current effective base URL is displayed; editing + Save persists override to `localStorage` and subsequent `apiRequest()` calls use it without reload.
- [ ] Whenever the URL is set (initial load, after Save, after Reset) an online/offline indication is shown: `checking` → `online` (HTTP 200 `{status:"ok"}` from `/health/`) or `offline` (network error/timeout/non-2xx), with checked URL, `role="status"`, and a Retry button.
- [ ] Offline backend (wrong URL or stopped Django) surfaces the red offline state instead of silently failing; online backend surfaces green within the 5 s timeout.
- [ ] Invalid input (empty, whitespace, wrong scheme) is rejected with an inline `role="alert"` error and does not persist.
- [ ] Reset restores the env default (`VITE_API_BASE_URL || "/api"`) and re-probes.
- [ ] Navbar links to Settings; theme toggle and existing `/` + `/projects` routes are unaffected.
- [ ] `pnpm test:run` and `pnpm check` pass for new/changed files.

## Dependencies
- **Internal**: Contract dependency on Feature 3 (`GET /health/` → `{status:"ok", db:"ok"}`) — implementable in parallel via the `systemApi.checkHealth` stub; no dependency on the registration route.
- **External**: None. Uses existing `wouter`, `lucide-react`, Vitest + React Testing Library.
